sentences.quote: In 2025, Valero stockholder cash returns totaled $4.0 billion, resulting in a payout ratio of 67 percent for the year.
sentences.text: Management frames its approach around a capital allocation framework prioritizing balance sheet strength, disciplined capital investments and shareholder returns, and delivered on it in 2025: stockholder cash returns totaled $4.0 billion, a 67 percent payout ratio, with the quarterly dividend raised 6 percent to $1.20 in January 2026 and net debt to capitalization of 18 percent at year-end.
Earnings remain cycle-driven, from a $595 million net loss in the first quarter of 2025 to $3.7 billion in the second quarter of 2026, with renewable diesel a weaker spot.
